name: ImageFilter
description: the function ImageFilter allows to execute a filter against a image.
syntax: ImageFilter( any image, string filtername, [struct parameters] )

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: filtername
params.description: the name of the filter executed (average,block,blur ...)

params.name: parameters
params.description: parameters for the filter defined with argument filtername
